title.zh: 免除省、市或市镇政府为兴建政府大楼、供水系统、市场及其他公共建筑（其后于第二次世界大战期间被毁）而负担的全部债务的法案
title.en: An Act to Condone All Debts Incurred By Provincial, City or Municipal Governments for the Purpose of Constructing Government Buildings, Waterworks Systems, Markets and Other Public Edifices Which Were Later Destroyed During World War II
title.orig: An Act to Condone All Debts Incurred By Provincial, City or Municipal Governments for the Purpose of Constructing Government Buildings, Waterworks Systems, Markets and Other Public Edifices Which Were Later Destroyed During World War II

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1953/ra_839_1953.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: All indebtedness incurred by provincial, city or municipal governments for the purpose of constructing government buildings, waterworks systems, markets and any other public edifices which were subsequently destroyed during the last world war and for which destructions no war damage payments were received by said local governments are hereby condoned by the National Government and if the provincial, city or municipal governments incurred said indebtedness from any bank, the same shall be assumed by the National Government.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, April 4, 1953.
